entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you with your VeloFit product today?
Hi David. I... I need to return something. It's the VeloBand Pulse monitor I bought a couple of weeks ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller, and the order number is... VF77819-PULSE.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on January 2nd. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Are you experiencing a technical fault or is it more of a preference?

Oh, no, it works fine. It's just... it's not really for me. To be honest, things are a little tight right now and I really needed that money back for some bills. I feel bad about it, I've been a VeloFit customer for years.
I completely understand, Sarah, and I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, I'm looking at our internal knowledge base here... and yes, it looks like you're well within the return period.
You can take it back? Oh, that's such a relief.
Absolutely. Our policy states that items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. Since you received it 14 days ago, you have plenty of time. I've just authorized the return in our system.
Thank you, David! I was so worried. You've really helped me out.

It's my pleasure, Sarah. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you so much again for making that so easy.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. Have a great day!
You too, Sarah. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
